```{r}
mc_short_name <- function(col) {
  sub(paste0("^", MC_PREFIX), "", col)
}

load_patient_metaclusters <- function(survival_df) {
  mc_cols <- grep(paste0("^", MC_PREFIX), names(survival_df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(mc_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No metacluster abundance columns found in survival_df.")
  }
  survival_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::any_of(c("patient_id", "rsf_risk", "risk_grp")),
      dplyr::all_of(mc_cols)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

spearman_mc_omics <- function(
  combined_df, mc_cols, feature_cols, cohort, omics_type, min_n = 10L
) {
  rows <- list()
  for (mc in mc_cols) {
    mc_vals <- combined_df[[mc]]
    for (feat in feature_cols) {
      feat_vals <- combined_df[[feat]]
      ok <- is.finite(mc_vals) & is.finite(feat_vals)
      n <- sum(ok)
      if (n < min_n) next
      ct <- tryCatch(
        stats::cor.test(mc_vals[ok], feat_vals[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(ct)) next
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        cohort = cohort, omics_type = omics_type,
        metacluster = mc_short_name(mc), mc_column = mc,
        feature = feat, rho = unname(ct$estimate), pval = ct$p.value, n = n,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}

fisher_meta_mc_omics <- function(cohort_results, min_cohorts = 2L) {
  if (length(cohort_results) < min_cohorts) {
    stop("Fisher meta requires at least ", min_cohorts, " cohort result tables.")
  }
  all <- dplyr::bind_rows(cohort_results)
  keys <- all %>% dplyr::distinct(.data$omics_type, .data$metacluster, .data$feature)

  meta_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(keys)), function(i) {
    row <- keys[i, , drop = FALSE]
    sub <- all %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$omics_type == row$omics_type,
        .data$metacluster == row$metacluster,
        .data$feature == row$feature
      )
    pvals <- sub$pval[is.finite(sub$pval)]
    rhos <- sub$rho[is.finite(sub$rho)]
    n_cohorts <- length(pvals)
    fisher_p <- if (n_cohorts >= min_cohorts) {
      stats::pchisq(-2 * sum(log(pvals)), df = 2 * n_cohorts, lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else NA_real_
    mean_rho <- mean(rhos, na.rm = TRUE)
    sign_agree <- if (length(rhos) >= 2L) {
      sum(rhos > 0) == length(rhos) || sum(rhos < 0) == length(rhos)
    } else NA
    out <- data.frame(
      omics_type = row$omics_type, metacluster = row$metacluster, feature = row$feature,
      fisher_p = fisher_p, fisher_padj = NA_real_, n_cohorts = n_cohorts,
      mean_rho = mean_rho, sign_consistent = sign_agree, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    for (cn in unique(sub$cohort)) {
      cs <- sub[sub$cohort == cn, , drop = FALSE]
      out[[paste0("rho_", cn)]] <- cs$rho[1]
      out[[paste0("pval_", cn)]] <- cs$pval[1]
      out[[paste0("n_", cn)]] <- cs$n[1]
    }
    out
  })
  meta <- dplyr::bind_rows(meta_rows)
  ok_fisher <- is.finite(meta$fisher_p)
  meta$fisher_padj[ok_fisher] <- stats::p.adjust(meta$fisher_p[ok_fisher], method = "BH")
  meta[order(meta$fisher_padj, meta$fisher_p, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
}
```

```{r}
aggregate_omics_to_patient <- function(
  scores_long, patient_col = "patient_id", feature_col,
  value_col = "score", sample_col = "sample_id"
) {
  if (!patient_col %in% names(scores_long)) {
    stop("Column not found: ", patient_col)
  }
  scores_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[patient_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[patient_col]], .data[[feature_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      value = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .data[[feature_col]], values_from = value) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(patient_col) %>%
    as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
}

run_progeny_cohort_patient_wide <- function(expr_mat, sample_meta) {
  sample_meta <- sample_meta %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$patient_id), .data$sample_id %in% colnames(expr_mat))
  if (nrow(sample_meta) < 3L) return(NULL)
  expr <- expr_mat[, sample_meta$sample_id, drop = FALSE]
  progeny <- run_progeny_mlm(expr)
  acts_long <- progeny_activities_to_long(progeny$activities, sample_meta)
  aggregate_omics_to_patient(
    acts_long, patient_col = "patient_id", feature_col = "pathway",
    value_col = "score", sample_col = "sample_id"
  )
}

join_mc_with_omics <- function(mc_df, omics_patient_wide) {
  common <- intersect(mc_df$patient_id, rownames(omics_patient_wide))
  if (length(common) == 0L) {
    stop("No overlapping patients between metaclusters and omics scores.")
  }
  mc_sub <- mc_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$patient_id %in% common) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>%
    as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
  omics_sub <- omics_patient_wide[common, , drop = FALSE]
  cbind(mc_sub, omics_sub)
}
```

```{r}
wilcox_mc_presence_omics <- function(
  combined_df, mc_col, feature_cols, cohort, omics_type, min_n_per_group = 3L
) {
  mc_vals <- combined_df[[mc_col]]
  present <- mc_vals > 0

  rows <- list()
  for (feat in feature_cols) {
    feat_vals <- combined_df[[feat]]
    ok <- is.finite(feat_vals) & !is.na(present)
    n_present <- sum(present[ok])
    n_absent  <- sum(!present[ok])
    if (n_present < min_n_per_group || n_absent < min_n_per_group) next

    x_present <- feat_vals[ok & present]
    x_absent  <- feat_vals[ok & !present]
    wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x_present, x_absent, exact = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(wt)) next

    U <- wt$statistic
    n1 <- length(x_present); n2 <- length(x_absent)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * U) / (n1 * n2)

    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      cohort = cohort, omics_type = omics_type, metacluster = "MC_47",
      feature = feat, median_present = median(x_present, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_absent = median(x_absent, na.rm = TRUE),
      rho = r_rb, pval = wt$p.value,
      n_present = n1, n_absent = n2, n = n1 + n2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}

mc47_col <- "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_47"

                   "NFkB","PI3K","TGFb","TNFa","Trail","VEGF","WNT","p53")

mc47_cohort_results <- lapply(names(combined_by_cohort), function(cn) {

    combined_by_cohort[[cn]], mc_col = mc47_col,
    feature_cols = intersect(pathway_cols, colnames(combined_by_cohort[[cn]])),
    cohort = cn, omics_type = "PROGENy"
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

df <- read_csv("top10_vimp_progeny_fisher_meta.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# --- Risk grouping, based on RSF clinical risk score correlation ---
LOW_RISK  <- c("MC_13", "MC_7", "MC_30", "MC_6", "MC_17")
HIGH_RISK <- c("MC_0", "MC_5", "MC_10", "MC_47")
# MC_8 not present in the RSF-risk plot -> marked Unclassified

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    risk_group = case_when(
      metacluster %in% HIGH_RISK ~ "High-risk",
      metacluster %in% LOW_RISK  ~ "Low-risk",
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    ),
    risk_group = factor(risk_group, levels = c("Low-risk", "High-risk", "Unclassified")),
    sig_label = ifelse(!is.na(fisher_padj) & fisher_padj <= 0.05, "*", "")
  )

# Order metaclusters: low-risk block, then high-risk block, then unclassified
mc_order <- c(LOW_RISK, HIGH_RISK, setdiff(unique(df$metacluster), c(LOW_RISK, HIGH_RISK)))
df$metacluster <- factor(df$metacluster, levels = rev(mc_order))  # rev so low-risk appears at top

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = feature, y = metacluster, fill = mean_rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 5, vjust = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#B03A2E", mid = "white", high = "#2E7D32",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Mean\nSpearman ρ",
    limits = c(-max(abs(df$mean_rho)), max(abs(df$mean_rho)))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Metacluster–PROGENy Pathway Associations",
    subtitle = "Grouped by RSF risk group; * = FDR-adjusted p \u2264 0.05",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey30")
  )

# Add separating lines between risk-group blocks
n_low  <- length(LOW_RISK)
n_high <- length(HIGH_RISK)
n_total <- length(mc_order)

p <- p +
  geom_hline(yintercept = n_total - n_low + 0.5, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = n_total - n_low - n_high + 0.5, linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed")

p

ggsave("mc_progeny_heatmap.png", plot = p, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Rebuild combined_by_cohort from scratch
# (mirrors what run_metacluster_progeny_xcell_correlation()
#  does internally, but stops after the join step so we can
#  reuse the combined data frames directly)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p <- resolve_progeny_paths()

survival_path <- file.path(p$proteomics, "survival_df_with_risk.rds")
survival_df <- readRDS(survival_path)

mc_df <- load_patient_metaclusters(survival_df)
mc_cols <- grep(paste0("^", MC_PREFIX), names(mc_df), value = TRUE)

cohort_loaders <- list(
  Stage2        = function() load_stage2_expression_meta(p, survival_df),
  Retrospective = function() load_retrospective_expression_meta(p, survival_df),
  Colossus      = function() load_colossus_expression_meta(p, survival_df),
  Taxonomy      = function() load_taxonomy_expression_meta(p, survival_path)
)

combined_by_cohort <- list()

for (cn in names(cohort_loaders)) {
  message("Building combined data: ", cn)

  dat <- cohort_loaders[[cn]]()
  omics_wide <- run_progeny_cohort_patient_wide(dat$expr, dat$meta)

  if (is.null(omics_wide) || ncol(omics_wide) == 0) {
    warning("Skipping ", cn, " (no patient-level PROGENy scores).")
    next
  }

  combined <- join_mc_with_omics(mc_df, omics_wide)
  combined_by_cohort[[cn]] <- combined

  message("  ", cn, ": ", nrow(combined), " patients, ",
          ncol(combined), " columns")
}

# Quick check
names(combined_by_cohort)
sapply(combined_by_cohort, nrow)
```

```{r}

library(decoupleR)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

GREEN <- "#2E7D32"
RED   <- "#B03A2E"

pathways_of_interest <- c("JAK-STAT", "NFkB", "PI3K", "WNT", "p53")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Get PROGENy footprint genes (top N by weight per pathway)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

progeny_net <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = "human", top = 500)

top_genes_per_pathway <- progeny_net %>%
  filter(source %in% pathways_of_interest) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  slice_max(abs(weight), n = 12) %>%
  ungroup()

all_genes <- unique(top_genes_per_pathway$target)
cat("Total unique genes across 5 pathways:", length(all_genes), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Pull real protein-protein interactions among these genes (STRINGdb)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if (!requireNamespace("STRINGdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("STRINGdb")
}
library(STRINGdb)

string_db <- STRINGdb$new(version = "12.0", species = 9606, score_threshold = 400)

mapped <- string_db$map(data.frame(gene = all_genes), "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)

string_edges <- string_db$get_interactions(mapped$STRING_id)

id_to_symbol <- setNames(mapped$gene, mapped$STRING_id)
ppi_sub <- string_edges %>%
  mutate(
    source_genesymbol = id_to_symbol[from],
    target_genesymbol = id_to_symbol[to]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(source_genesymbol), !is.na(target_genesymbol))

cat("Edges found among footprint genes:", nrow(ppi_sub), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Pull group-mean correlation strength per pathway
# ---------------------------------------------------------

LOW_RISK  <- c("MC_13", "MC_7", "MC_30", "MC_6", "MC_17")
HIGH_RISK <- c("MC_0", "MC_5", "MC_10", "MC_47")

meta <- read_csv("top10_vimp_progeny_fisher_meta.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    risk_group = case_when(
      metacluster %in% HIGH_RISK ~ "High-risk",
      metacluster %in% LOW_RISK  ~ "Low-risk",
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(risk_group %in% c("Low-risk", "High-risk"))

group_rho <- meta %>%
  filter(feature %in% pathways_of_interest) %>%
  group_by(feature, risk_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_rho = mean(mean_rho, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Network-building function (base igraph, no ggraph needed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

build_pathway_network_base <- function(pathway_name, node_color, rho_value) {
  genes <- top_genes_per_pathway %>%
    filter(source == pathway_name) %>%
    pull(target)

  edges <- ppi_sub %>%
    filter(source_genesymbol %in% genes, target_genesymbol %in% genes)

  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    d = if (nrow(edges) > 0) edges %>% select(source_genesymbol, target_genesymbol) else
      data.frame(source_genesymbol = character(0), target_genesymbol = character(0)),
    vertices = data.frame(name = genes),
    directed = FALSE
  )

  rho_label <- if (is.na(rho_value)) "NA" else sprintf("%.2f", rho_value)

  plot(
    g,
    vertex.color = node_color,
    vertex.size = 20,
    vertex.label.cex = 0.65,
    vertex.label.color = "black",
    vertex.frame.color = "black",
    edge.color = "grey70",
    layout = layout_with_fr(g),
    main = paste0(pathway_name, " (\u03c1 = ", rho_label, ")")
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Filter to only pathways UP (positive mean rho) in each group
# ---------------------------------------------------------

low_risk_up <- group_rho %>%
  filter(risk_group == "Low-risk", mean_rho > 0) %>%
  pull(feature)

high_risk_up <- group_rho %>%
  filter(risk_group == "High-risk", mean_rho > 0) %>%
  pull(feature)

cat("Low-risk pathways (up):", paste(low_risk_up, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("High-risk pathways (up):", paste(high_risk_up, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Build the two figures
# ---------------------------------------------------------

n_low <- length(low_risk_up)
if (n_low > 0) {
  png("pathway_networks_low_risk.png", width = 480 * n_low, height = 550, res = 150)
  par(mfrow = c(1, n_low), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
  for (p in low_risk_up) {
    rho_val <- group_rho %>% filter(feature == p, risk_group == "Low-risk") %>% pull(mean_rho)
    build_pathway_network_base(p, GREEN, rho_val[1])
  }
  mtext("Low-Risk Metacluster Pathway Networks", outer = TRUE, line = -1.5, cex = 1.2, font = 2)
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("No pathways with positive mean rho in Low-risk group.")
}

n_high <- length(high_risk_up)
if (n_high > 0) {
  png("pathway_networks_high_risk.png", width = 480 * n_high, height = 550, res = 150)
  par(mfrow = c(1, n_high), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
  for (p in high_risk_up) {
    rho_val <- group_rho %>% filter(feature == p, risk_group == "High-risk") %>% pull(mean_rho)
    build_pathway_network_base(p, RED, rho_val[1])
  }
  mtext("High-Risk Metacluster Pathway Networks", outer = TRUE, line = -1.5, cex = 1.2, font = 2)
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("No pathways with positive mean rho in High-risk group.")
}

cat("Saved: pathway_networks_low_risk.png and pathway_networks_high_risk.png (where applicable)\n")

```
```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

LOW_RISK  <- c("MC_13", "MC_7")
HIGH_RISK <- c("MC_0", "MC_5")


df <- read_csv("top10_vimp_progeny_fisher_meta.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    risk_group = case_when(
      metacluster %in% HIGH_RISK ~ "High-risk",
      metacluster %in% LOW_RISK  ~ "Low-risk",
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Find pathways where low-risk and high-risk group means
# have OPPOSITE signs (i.e. genuinely diverge in direction)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

group_means <- df %>%
  filter(risk_group %in% c("Low-risk", "High-risk")) %>%
  group_by(feature, risk_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_rho = mean(mean_rho, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = risk_group, values_from = mean_rho)

opposite_pathways <- group_means %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`Low-risk`), !is.na(`High-risk`),
    sign(`Low-risk`) != sign(`High-risk`),
    `Low-risk` != 0, `High-risk` != 0
  ) %>%
  pull(feature)

cat("Pathways with opposite direction between risk groups:\n")
print(opposite_pathways)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Build matrices, restricted to only those diverging pathways
# ---------------------------------------------------------

build_risk_matrix <- function(df, risk_mcs, pathway_filter) {
  sub <- df %>%
    filter(metacluster %in% risk_mcs, feature %in% pathway_filter) %>%
    select(metacluster, feature, mean_rho) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = mean_rho) %>%
    column_to_rownames("metacluster") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  sub <- sub[rowSums(!is.na(sub)) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  sub
}

low_risk_mat  <- build_risk_matrix(df, LOW_RISK, opposite_pathways)
high_risk_mat <- build_risk_matrix(df, HIGH_RISK, opposite_pathways)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Shared pathway (column) order
# ---------------------------------------------------------

combined_mat <- rbind(low_risk_mat, high_risk_mat)
col_cor <- cor(combined_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
col_dist <- as.dist(1 - col_cor)
col_clust <- hclust(col_dist, method = "complete")
shared_pathway_order <- colnames(combined_mat)[col_clust$order]

low_risk_mat  <- low_risk_mat[, shared_pathway_order, drop = FALSE]
high_risk_mat <- high_risk_mat[, shared_pathway_order, drop = FALSE]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Shared diverging color scale
# ---------------------------------------------------------

max_abs <- max(abs(c(low_risk_mat, high_risk_mat)), na.rm = TRUE)
breaks <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 101)
diverging_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pheatmap(
  low_risk_mat,
  color = diverging_colors,
  breaks = breaks,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 9,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  clustering_method = "complete",
  na_col = "grey90",
  main = "Low-Risk Metaclusters\nPathways diverging from High-risk group",
  filename = "low_risk_mc_pathway_heatmap.png",
  width = 7, height = 5
)

pheatmap(
  high_risk_mat,
  color = diverging_colors,
  breaks = breaks,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 9,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  clustering_method = "complete",
  na_col = "grey90",
  main = "High-Risk Metaclusters\nPathways diverging from Low-risk group",
  filename = "high_risk_mc_pathway_heatmap.png",
  width = 7, height = 5
)

cat("Saved: low_risk_mc_pathway_heatmap.png and high_risk_mc_pathway_heatmap.png\n")
```
